headlines.title: 上半年信贷投向出炉 金融资源向新质生产力集聚
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月29日讯，中国人民银行昨天（28日）公布上半年信贷投向。上半年，人民币贷款增加了10.72万亿元。梳理贷款投向，上半年信贷资金流向呈现明显结构性变化。传统房地产贷款增速放缓，而聚焦科技创新等领域的贷款增速亮眼，金融资源正向科创、算力新基建等新质生产力领域加速集聚。

headlines.title_en: H1 credit allocation released: financial resources concentrate on new productive forces
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data July 29: PBOC released H1 credit direction data. Yuan loans increased by 10.72 trillion yuan in H1, with structural shifts: traditional real estate loans slowed, while loans to tech innovation and other sectors grew strongly, accelerating financial resources toward new productive forces like AI, computing infrastructure.

headlines.title: 合肥上半年GDP为7073亿元，同比增长6.8%
headlines.summary: 合肥市统计局发布2026年上半年合肥经济运行情况。根据地区生产总值统一核算结果，上半年，全市地区生产总值（GDP）7073亿元，按不变价格计算，同比增长6.8%，高于全国水平（4.7%），持平于合肥市今年一季度GDP增速。分产业看，第一产业增加值118.8亿元，增长2.2%；第二产业增加值2552.4亿元，增长10.3%；第三产业增加值4401.8亿元，增长5.0%。上半年，全市规模以上工业增加值同比增长25.6%，创近年来新高；社会消费品零售总额2800.58亿元，同比增长0.6%。

headlines.title_en: Hefei's H1 GDP reached 707.3 billion yuan, up 6.8% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Hefei Bureau of Statistics released H1 2026 economic data: GDP reached 707.3 billion yuan, up 6.8% YoY at constant prices, above national 4.7% and flat vs Q1. By sector: primary industry 11.88 billion (+2.2%), secondary 255.24 billion (+10.3%), tertiary 440.18 billion (+5.0%). Industrial value-added above designated size surged 25.6% YoY, a multi-year high; retail sales totaled 280.058 billion, up 0.6% YoY.

headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.
The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...
headlines.title_zh: 新加坡投资者现已成为香港写字楼资产的最大海外买家
headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际数据显示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产的最大非本地买家群体，受惠于香港写字楼市场低迷期间不良资产价格大幅回调的吸引。鉴于写字楼资产价格仍处低位，未来数月新加坡资金需求预计将保持稳定。

headlines.title: 央行上海总部：继续深化自由贸易账户功能升级试点
headlines.summary: 【央行上海总部：继续深化自由贸易账户功能升级试点】人民银行上海总部召开2026年第三季度新闻发布会，人民银行上海总部宏观审慎管理部副主任施建东表示，上半年，上海自由贸易账户功能升级试点参与主体稳步扩容。该项工作自2025年12月正式启动以来，目前已有11家银行、42家优质企业参与试点，服务对象广泛涵盖了央国企、外资、民营等多类经济主体，服务汽车制造、现代农业、半导体等多个行业领域，试点项下跨境资金收付规模折合人民币已超过1330亿元。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Shanghai HQ: Continue deepening pilot upgrades of free trade account functions
headlines.summary_en: 【PBOC Shanghai: Continue to upgrade FT account functions】 PBOC Shanghai held Q3 2026 press conference; Macropru Management Dept Deputy Director Shi Jiandong said H1 saw steady expansion of FT account pilot participants. Since launch in Dec 2025, 11 banks and 42 high-quality enterprises have joined, covering SOEs, foreign firms, private enterprises, auto, agri-tech, semiconductors; cross-border payments under pilot exceeded 133 billion yuan.

headlines.title: 经济学家：市场料将更多关注美联储信号，较少关注利率决定
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月29日讯，市场普遍预计美联储将维持联邦基金利率不变，但Generali Investments高级经济学家Paolo Zanghieri在一份报告中表示，更重要的事情将是美联储传递的信息。预计，随着持续的通胀、油价上涨以及美联储内部的分歧为今年晚些时候进一步紧缩政策敞开大门，决策者将维持甚至强化偏紧缩的基调。这符合Generali更广泛的预期，即尽管整体通胀有所缓解，但粘性通胀将使央行保持谨慎。市场将较少关注利率决定本身，而更多地关注有关9月会议以及通胀风险与经济增长之间平衡的任何信号。

headlines.title_en: Economists: Market expected to focus more on Fed signals, less on rate decisions
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data July 29: Market widely expects Fed to hold rates, but Generali Investments senior economist Paolo Zanghieri notes the key is Fed's messaging. Expects policymakers to maintain or even strengthen hawkish tone as sticky inflation, oil prices, and Fed divisions open door for further tightening later this year. Generali expects sticky inflation to keep central banks cautious despite easing headline inflation. Market focus on any signals about September meeting and trade-off between inflation risks and growth.

headlines.title: “十五五”期间单位国内生产总值二氧化碳排放将降低17%
headlines.summary: 生态环境部会同国家发展改革委等18个部门联合发布《国家应对气候变化“十五五”规划》。根据《规划》，到2030年，单位国内生产总值二氧化碳排放较2025年降低17%，全国碳排放权交易市场覆盖行业单位产品二氧化碳排放比2025年下降3%左右，建成诚信透明、方法统一、参与广泛、与国际接轨的全国温室气体自愿减排交易市场，产品碳足迹管理体系基本建成，加强非二氧化碳温室气体监测管控，形成3000万吨二氧化碳当量减排能力，适应气候变化工作体系更加完善，气候适应型社会建设取得阶段性进展，应对气候变化意识和能力持续增强。我国在全球气候治理中的影响力、引导力、塑造力和道义感

headlines.title_en: Carbon dioxide emissions per unit of GDP will be reduced by 17% during the 15th Five-Year Plan period.
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Ecology and Environment, together with the National Development and Reform Commission and 16 other departments, jointly issued the 'National Climate Change 15th Five-Year Plan.' According to the plan, by 2030, CO2 emissions per unit of GDP will be 17% lower than in 2025; CO2 emissions per unit product in industries covered by the national carbon emissions trading market will be about 3% lower than 2025; a national greenhouse gas voluntary emissions reduction trading market that is honest and transparent, with unified methods, broad participation, and aligned with international standards will be established; the product carbon footprint management system will be basically completed; monitoring and control of non-CO2 greenhouse gases will be strengthened; a CO2 equivalent emission reduction capacity of 30 million tons will be formed; the climate adaptation work system will be further improved; construction of a climate-resilient society will achieve phased progress; and climate change awareness and capacity will continue to be enhanced. China's influence, leadership, shaping power, and moral authority in global climate governance will be strengthened.
